title: Practical Estimation of the Bayes Optimal Fairness-Accuracy Tradeoff with Soft Labels
abstract: arXiv:2611.06027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: There is a fundamental limit to the best prediction error of any model for a given data distribution. In classification, the Bayes error quantifies this limit and serves as both a benchmark for trained models and a criterion to detect overfitting. The state-of-the-art Bayes error estimation techniques for binary classification use only soft labels (positive class probabilities) and require no input features or auxiliary training. We extend such notions to constrained classification problems, such as fairness. Fair classification is an important case of constrained or multi-objective classification. It requires a model not only to be accurate but also to yield fair outcomes (equal or near-equal true positive rates) across different demographic groups (e.g., race and gender). translated_title: 基于软标签的贝叶斯最优公平性-准确性权衡的实用估计
translated_abstract: 对于给定的数据分布，任何模型所能达到的最佳预测误差都存在一个根本性的极限。在分类任务中，贝叶斯误差量化了这一极限，它既可以作为训练模型的性能基准，也可以作为检测过拟合的标准。目前最先进的二分类贝叶斯误差估计技术仅使用软标签（即正类概率），而无需输入特征或辅助训练。我们将这些概念扩展到受约束的分类问题，例如公平性。公平分类是受约束或多目标分类的一个重要案例，它要求模型不仅要准确，还要在不同人口群体（如种族和性别）之间产生公平的结果（即相等或接近相等的真阳性率）。这导致了固有的公平性-准确性权衡，即帕累托前沿，用于对各个公平分类器进行相互比较。我们工作的重点是将（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将仅基于软标签的贝叶斯误差估计技术从标准二分类扩展到公平分类等受约束分类问题，实现了对贝叶斯最优公平性-准确性权衡（帕累托前沿）的实用估计。
en_tdlr: This paper extends state-of-the-art Bayes error estimation techniques that rely only on soft labels to constrained (fair) classification problems, enabling practical estimation of the Bayes optimal fairness-accuracy tradeoff (Pareto frontier).
